Playing Google Widevine test DASH via MediaItem.DrmConfiguration. License: Google UAT test proxy (Media3 demo). Not a production license server.
Playing the same Google Widevine test stream with DefaultDrmSessionManager and HttpMediaDrmCallback. License: Google UAT test proxy.
Playing custom Widevine DASH. License URI from BuildConfig: %1$s
Playing the matching clear (unencrypted) Tears of Steel DASH stream. No license server is used.
Custom Widevine is not started. Set drm.widevine.licenseUri (and optionally drm.widevine.manifestUri) in gradle.properties, then rebuild. This sample will not invent a license server.

ClearKey is not started. Media3 supports C.CLEARKEY_UUID, but this sample ships neither keys nor a license server. Set drm.clearkey.manifestUri plus drm.clearkey.licenseUri, or a local W3C keys JSON via drm.clearkey.keysFile, then rebuild.
Playing ClearKey DASH with license URI %1$s. Keys must be issued by that server for this manifest.
Playing ClearKey DASH with LocalMediaDrmCallback and developer-supplied keys JSON. Keys are not bundled in the public sample.
Widevine CDM is not available on this device/emulator (MediaDrm.isCryptoSchemeSupported returned false). Use a Google Play system image, or play Clear DASH instead.
ClearKey CDM is not available on this device (MediaDrm.isCryptoSchemeSupported). That is a platform limitation, not a missing license URL.
Playback error: %1$s
A DRM error occurred (ERROR_CODE_DRM_UNSPECIFIED). Check the device CDM and license server logs; this app does not fabricate a license.
ERROR_CODE_DRM_SCHEME_UNSUPPORTED: this UUID is not supported on this device (common on AOSP emulators without Widevine).
ERROR_CODE_DRM_PROVISIONING_FAILED: the CDM could not provision. Often network or Google provisioning, not a missing app key.
ERROR_CODE_DRM_CONTENT_ERROR: the stream’s DRM init data does not match the session (wrong manifest, or license for a different asset).

ERROR_CODE_DRM_LICENSE_ACQUISITION_FAILED: the license HTTP request failed or returned an unusable response. For Google test content this is the UAT proxy; for custom content you must supply a real license URL.
ERROR_CODE_DRM_DISALLOWED_OPERATION: the CDM refused an operation (security level, output protection, or policy).
ERROR_CODE_DRM_SYSTEM_ERROR: the platform MediaDrm stack failed. See logcat for the CDM vendor message.
ERROR_CODE_DRM_DEVICE_REVOKED: this device’s Widevine credential was revoked by the license service.
ERROR_CODE_DRM_LICENSE_EXPIRED: the license is no longer valid. Request a new license from your real license server.
Force app license URI (ignore MPD LicenseUrl)
On. ExoPlayer will not follow a per-period or in-band LicenseUrl. The Google Tears of Steel test MPD is typically a single period, so this is a no-op until you load a multi-period asset.
forceDefaultLicenseUri=true (app license URI wins over the MPD).
DRM session log: waiting for DrmSessionEventListener callbacks (acquire / keys loaded / error / release). These events do not include keys.
